extracted.name: Creamy Cucumber Salad with Lemon Yogurt Dressing
extracted.description: Recipe video above. A beautiful tangy, refreshing Cucumber Salad! The yogurt dressing pairs beautifully with the fresh cucumber. Great side salad for Middle Eastern food, Greek, Indian and rich meat-heavy mains like Roasts.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup mint leaves (, finely chopped (or 2 tsp dried mint))
1 cup yogurt (, full fat (Greek or plain))
instruction_lines: Dressing: Mix ingredients then leave for 20 minutes for the flavours to develop.
Cucumber: Cut cucumber in half lengthwise, then slice into 3mm / 1/8" thick slices.
Toss: Place cucumber, onion and mint in a bowl. Pour over Dressing and toss, then serve.
